**Analysis of each wrong answer:**

- **B. écrivait**: This is the imparfait (imperfect) tense, not the plus-que-parfait. The plus-que-parfait requires an auxiliary verb (avait) plus past participle.

- **C. aurait écrites**: This is the conditionnel passé (past conditional), formed with "aurait" instead of "avait". Not the plus-que-parfait.

- **D. avait écrivant**: While it starts with the correct auxiliary "avait", it incorrectly uses the present participle "écrivant" instead of the past participle "écrit/écrites". This is grammatically invalid after an auxiliary verb.
